rejects.event: A Confucian temple was built in Kumemura as a gift from the Kangxi Emperor.
rejects.quote: A Confucian temple, the gift of the Kangxi Emperor, was built in Kumemura in the 1670s; the Meirindō, a school of classic Confucian Chinese learning, was established in 1718.
rejects.why: The source quote states the temple was built in the '1670s', not specifically the exact year 1670.
